proxmox_plugin_description: Lets agents manage QEMU virtual machines that you explicitly allow on Proxmox VE servers, attach ISOs, change boot order and power state, and use live VNC consoles beside a conversation.
proxmox_start_failed: The Proxmox plugin could not read its servers. Restart Mannie, then turn the plugin on again.

match.countPlural=one: Turning off Proxmox closes 1 open VNC console session and clears cached Proxmox sign-ins.
match.countPlural=other: Turning off Proxmox closes {count: number} open VNC console sessions and clears cached Proxmox sign-ins.

proxmox_settings_description: Proxmox VE servers where agents can work with QEMU virtual machines that you explicitly allow. Passwords stay in your system credential store.
proxmox_list_failed_title: The Proxmox servers could not be loaded
proxmox_empty_description: Add a Proxmox VE server with a user account and password, then choose which QEMU virtual machines Mannie may access.
proxmox_allowed_vms_none: No VMs allowed yet. Choose VMs before agents can see or manage them.
proxmox_test_passed: Connected to {server}. {visible} QEMU VM(s) visible; {allowed} allowed for Mannie.
proxmox_server_description: New servers start with zero VMs allowed. After saving, Mannie walks you through choosing which VMs to expose.
proxmox_edit_endpoint_warning: Changing the host or port clears the server's pinned TLS certificate and its allowed VM list.
proxmox_field_name_description: A short name for this server, shown in Settings, mentions, and approvals.
proxmox_field_host_description: The Proxmox VE hostname or IP address, without https:// or a port.
proxmox_field_username_description: Proxmox username including its realm, such as alice@pve or admin@pam. Regular non-admin accounts are recommended.
proxmox_field_password_description: Stored in your operating system credential store and never written to SQLite, logs, or transcripts.
proxmox_field_password_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
proxmox_field_note_description: Optional context about this server for agents. It grants no permissions.
proxmox_field_note_placeholder: Optional context, such as which VMs live on this server
proxmox_invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to 64 characters without control characters.
proxmox_invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address without a scheme, port, or path.
proxmox_invalid_port: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.
proxmox_invalid_username: Enter a Proxmox username with realm, such as user@pve.
proxmox_invalid_note: Shorten the note to at most 512 characters.
proxmox_cert_description: Inspect the server's presented leaf certificate without sending your password. Pin it only if the SHA-256 fingerprint matches your Proxmox node.
proxmox_cert_os_trusted: Trusted by your operating system certificate store. Pinning is optional.
proxmox_cert_not_os_trusted: Not trusted by your operating system certificate store. Pin this leaf certificate to connect without modifying system trust.
proxmox_cert_mismatch_warning: This server presented a different certificate than the one you pinned. Mannie will not send credentials until you pin the new certificate.
proxmox_cert_expired_warning: This certificate is outside its validity period and cannot be used.
proxmox_cert_matches_pin: This certificate matches the currently pinned fingerprint.
proxmox_vms_description: Only selected QEMU virtual machines are visible or accessible to agents. Unselected VMs and newly created VMs stay hidden.
proxmox_vms_empty: This Proxmox account has no visible QEMU virtual machines.
proxmox_remove_description: Mannie deletes the stored password, clears the allowed VM list, and closes any open VNC console sessions for this server.
proxmox_control_empty: No allowed Proxmox VMs configured yet.
proxmox_panel_agent_hint: Watching live console. Click Take over to type passwords or control the VM directly.
proxmox_panel_owner_hint: You have control. Agent VNC tools are paused until you click Resume agent. Press Ctrl+Alt+Escape to leave keyboard capture.
proxmox_mention_server_not_found: That Proxmox server is no longer registered.
proxmox_mention_vm_not_allowed: That Proxmox VM is not in the allowed VMs list.
proxmox_error_name_taken: Another Proxmox server already uses that name.
proxmox_error_server_not_found: The Proxmox server is no longer registered.
proxmox_error_password_missing: No password is stored for this Proxmox server. Edit the server to set one.
proxmox_error_credentials_failed: The system credential store could not read or save the password.
proxmox_error_storage_failed: Mannie could not save the Proxmox configuration.
proxmox_error_vm_not_allowed: That VM is not in the allowed VMs list for Mannie.
proxmox_error_vm_not_found: That VM was not found on the Proxmox server.
proxmox_error_connection_failed: Could not reach the Proxmox server. Check host, port, and network connectivity.
proxmox_error_certificate_untrusted: The server's TLS certificate is not trusted by this computer. Inspect and pin its leaf certificate first.
proxmox_error_certificate_mismatch: The server presented a different TLS certificate than the pinned fingerprint. Inspect the certificate again.
proxmox_error_certificate_expired: The server's TLS certificate is expired or not yet valid.
proxmox_error_certificate_inspect_failed: Could not inspect the server's TLS certificate.
proxmox_error_pin_mismatch: The server's certificate changed while pinning. Inspect it again before pinning.
proxmox_error_authentication_failed: Proxmox rejected the username/realm or password.
proxmox_error_tfa_unsupported: This Proxmox account requires two-factor authentication, which is not supported in this version.
proxmox_error_permission_denied: This Proxmox account lacks permission for that operation.
proxmox_error_api_error: The Proxmox API returned an error.
proxmox_error_timeout: The Proxmox server did not respond in time.
proxmox_error_owner_in_control: You currently have control of the live VNC console. Click Resume agent to return control.
proxmox_error_agent_in_control: The agent currently has control of the live VNC console. Click Take over first.
proxmox_error_session_not_found: No live VNC session is open for that VM.
proxmox_error_too_many_sessions: Too many live VNC consoles are open. Close one before opening another.
proxmox_error_invalid_request: The Proxmox request was not valid.
proxmox_error_target_changed: The Proxmox server, TLS pin, or VM allowlist changed after approval.
